_about: Fracture statistics used to generate the discrete fracture networks (Table 1 of the paper). Orientations, counts and measured P10 are from the KURT borehole discontinuity survey (99 joints; Namgung et al., 2025). P32 is the dfnGen input calibrated so that the simulated P10 along vertical scanlines reproduces the measured P10.

aperture._about: Lognormal, sampled independently per fracture. The measured (mechanical) apertures of the 24 open joints have geometric mean 4.616 mm and ln-standard deviation 0.5126; the hydraulic aperture is the sampled value times hydraulic_factor (geometric mean 0.10 mm). Permeability follows from the cubic law.
